item.title: Junta Resumes Population Census in Lashio as Dual Armed Groups Intensify Forced Recruitment
item.description: The military regime has resumed collecting population data in Lashio, Northern Shan State, raising fears that the move signals an imminent new round of military conscription following the junta’s partial return to the city.
